newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to list 25 percent of Biman airline.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to list 25 percent of Biman airline.

text.p: Bangladesh has decided to list 25 percent of the national Biman airline on the local bourse, newspapers reported on Monday.
The decision was taken "in principle" on Sunday at a meeting of the state-owned airline's board of directors, headed by Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.
The board has yet to fix any schedule for the listing, the Daily Star newspaper said.
Hasina also asked a three-member committee to suggest how Biman, dogged by allegations of corruption and mismanagement, could improve its functioning and business, it said.
Biman ferried 1.3 million passengers and 32,000 tonnes of cargo in fiscal 1995/96 (July-June), officials said.
The Biman fleet has a total of 10 aircraft, including four long-haul McDonnell-Douglas DC-10s and two mid-haul Airbus A310s, flying to 26 international destinations.
